g.text: 214 NOAA reef regions, ordered by latitude within each source group
Source: NOAA Coral Reef Watch v3.1 regional virtual stations. DHW accumulates sustained heat stress over 12 weeks.
Thresholds describe heat-stress conditions, not observed bleaching or spawning failure. Regions receive equal weight; facets follow NOAA's geographic groups, with duplicate listings assigned once.
Annual maxima across 214 NOAA regions, 1986–2024. Each row is a region; each column is a year.
Severe heat stress now reaches most monitored reef regions
